observations.resulting_sequencer_behaviour: The note recorded with active Step length 16 replayed after 2,665 ms. At the visible rate 1/8T and tempo 120 this is 16 approximately 166.6 ms step intervals. A later Step-1 control confirmed this parameter is loop length, not a record-position selector.

comparison.only_intended_difference: set active Step length to 16 before the one-note recording
comparison.differential_result: This fixture disproves the previous 15-step-capacity interpretation: active Step length 16 produces a 2,665 ms / 16-step playback cycle.
